head: 787c6b2
lede: Every system in the Swords & Sandals II team-arena project and where it stands: from what still needs design, left, to what is done, right. Cards come from a code-checked inventory; click one for its evidence, gaps and next step.

cards.title: Verification tier of the whole SS2 rule set
cards.summary: One rule set, map-derived, drives every playable host (hotseat, arena, campaign). It declares itself map-derived and runtimeVerified:false. rule-set.js blocks any claim to the runtime-verified tier unless the rule set declares it, and none does.
cards.gaps: Runtime backing covers only the attack ingress for directions 1-12. No capture has ever watched this module drive a fight.
cards.next: Pick the next capture family and derive its candidates from the map, not from design: spell ingress or the tournament/armoured family.
cards.evidence: src/team/ss2-rules.js:9294-9720 (createSs2TeamRules; the id prints as ss2-map-derived-tournament, verification map-derived); src/team/rule-set.js:26-46,221-260; the provenance note says 'stamina economy, action legality and AI policy ... have no runtime backing at all'. I ran the engine test subset (ss2-*, team-*, engine, seeded-play-pins, stable-order, map-derived-tier, hotseat; ss2-observation excluded because it writes temp files): 1473 tests, 1472 pass, 0 fail, 1 skipped (the raw-trace archive check, which is expected).

cards.title: Melee attacks: quick / normal / power (drawn direction 1-12)
cards.summary: These are the only verbs with runtime goldens. Each band draws its own direction (randomBetween 1-4, 5-8, 9-12) and then runs checkattackroll through src/golden/ss2-attack-candidate.js. All 23 goldens replay through createTeamBattle/applyAction.
cards.gaps: 22 of the 23 goldens use fightMode misc, which play refuses (only tournament is allowed). Only one golden is armoured, none is enchanted, and all but one come from one staged tutorial opponent. The golden trace ECHOES roll labels and bounds from the candidate rather than observing them. In play the swing's stamina cost is AUTHORED (see the stamina item), so no golden covers the cost a player actually pays.
cards.next: Capture the tournament-boundary, armoured-* and champion-* candidates. 36 candidates have 0 observations. duel-firstblood-normal-kill has 1 and needs one more independent session.
cards.evidence: Ss2ActionType.QUICK/NORMAL/POWER_ATTACK (ss2-rules.js:310); test/ss2-golden-resolver-replay.test.js; the 23 goldens in test/fixtures/ss2-1v1-golden cover directions 1-12. I re-tallied them: fightMode is misc in 22 and tournament in 1, villain armourclass is 0 in 22 and 79 in 1, and enchantment potency is 0 in all 23.

cards.title: Stamina economy, rest and swing cost
cards.summary: The nextphase regen and heal, the per-phase costs, the zero-stamina forced rest and rest's own heal are map-derived. In play the swing cost is an AUTHORED weapon-mass formula (SS2_SWING, scale 20, strengthOffset 10) that replaces the build's round(strength*band). The build's formula is kept only under fixtureReplay.
cards.gaps: No part of the stamina economy has runtime backing. The goldens over-pin staminaleft (HANDOFF living-head open items). The swing cost is a deliberate, named divergence from the build.
cards.next: Re-run the swing-scale search whenever regen or the stat budget moves, as SS2_SWING.scale's own comment requires.
cards.evidence: ss2-rules.js:760-889 (SS2_SWING, ss2SwingCost); MAP_SILENCE 'swing-cost' in src/adapter/vanilla-fields.js; docs/combat-economy-findings-2026-09-10.md D2; the owner's decision of 2026-09-10 is cited in MAP_SILENCE.

cards.title: Movement: walk, rank change, taunted flee
cards.summary: walk-left and walk-right use the build's own displacement loop (ss2WalkDisplacement, movement_speed*16 eased). The taunted flee uses ss2RunDisplacement (*40, stop gap 10). rank-back and rank-front are AUTHORED verbs for the second axis, because the build has no sidestep.
cards.gaps: The walk and run displacements have no runtime observation. The movement step factors are guarded only by a tool run on the capture box (tools/walk-displacement-derivation.mjs), not by node --test.
cards.next: Get a pacing decision (frontX / walk distance), then re-census.
cards.evidence: Ss2ActionType.WALK_LEFT/RIGHT, RANK_BACK/FRONT, TAUNTED_PHASE; ss2-rules.js:2232-2400 (the step-factor table); resolveAction ~11120-11180 (the flee). The HANDOFF living head, around line 3011, measures pacing: 53% of a 3v3 is walking (35/48/91 actions).
cards.ownerDecision: The pacing number is recorded as the owner's decision, not a defect (HANDOFF.md ~3011). I found no recorded answer in the living head.

cards.title: Charge and jump verbs (the build has them; the engine has neither)
cards.summary: The build wires chargeleft/right and jumpleft/right on the warrior and archer controller frames (and Chargeattack on reach). The engine offers neither verb.
cards.gaps: The jump moves _y, which this engine already spends on rank depth, so a jump needs a third named axis. The jump's total displacement is unverified. The charge's mid-charge attack (Chargeattack) is unmodelled.
cards.next: Send a verifier at the jump-total reading, then design the leap axis before wiring anything.
cards.evidence: Battle map §Buttons wired per controller frame (docs/integration/ss2-battle-map.md:210-284); ss2-rules.js:2340-2394 (the charge is an advance gate; the jump total is 'ONE agent's reading with no verifier'); SS2_CROWD_ACTION already carries charge +2 and jump -2 (src/team/ss2-crowd.js).
cards.ownerDecision: Whether charge and jump belong in the team game at all, given the rank axis.

cards.title: Archer kit: bombard, snipe, bash_attack, swap_weapons, ammo
cards.summary: Built 2026-09-13 from the build's controller-frame table. The directions are the constants 21, 22 and 23, with no draw. There is an archer minimum range, a maximum-ammo tier chain, and a forced swap when the quiver is empty. Snipe is blocked by bodies (authored); bombard is lobbed.
cards.gaps: None has an observation. Arena residuals from the latest handoff: lob clearance counts only bodies in the rank the arrow is passing; the arrow stop reads a colossus'd target's live size; a strength-50 archer's arc overflows a zoom-80 stage. The three split-bow tournament bosses are normalised to proper archers (named divergence).
cards.next: Capture the three archer candidates. Decide the cross-rank lob-clearance rule.
cards.evidence: Ss2ActionType.BOMBARD/SNIPE/BASH_ATTACK/SWAP_WEAPONS; legalActions ~9972-10300; ss2MaximumAmmo (ss2-rules.js:1844); ss2ShotBlocked (~2631); test/ss2-ranged.test.js, test/ss2-projectile-endpoint.test.js. candidate-bombard-threshold, candidate-snipe-shield-boost and candidate-bash-inherited-critical each have 0 observations.
cards.ownerDecision: Cross-rank lob clearance (a policy call, named in the 2026-09-23-2119 handoff).

cards.title: Taunt and the taunted flee
cards.summary: Built 2026-09-17 to the map's full derivation: a pre-roll of 1-100 against taunt_percentage, then an effect draw of 1 or 2. Effect 1 is a direction-20 strike; effect 2 is a charisma*25 shove, or a flee if the defender holds a bow. By owner rule (2026-09-23) a taunt may target only a foe in the taunter's own rank.
cards.gaps: The direction-20 damage is corroborated by live traces but never promoted. candidate-taunt-charisma-floor has 0 observations. The own-rank rule is authored. An archer shooting across ranks is never offered its in-rank taunt.
cards.next: Stage a taunt capture for candidate-taunt-charisma-floor.
cards.evidence: SS2_TAUNT (ss2-rules.js:6806); ss2TauntValue (~3295); b81f3dc, 69e4217; test/ss2-taunt.test.js, test/ss2-ai-taunt.test.js; battle map §Direction 20 (the live traces adc7/adc20 show 300→297 = round(charisma*4)-1).
cards.ownerDecision: (1) Whether to change the demo roster so its duellist taunts in 3v3 (the engine is judged correct). (2) The archer's in-range taunt arm: the implementer's trial moved plain taunts 8→6 and tricks 123→150.

cards.title: Shove and knockback
cards.summary: Shove force is strength*12 boosted by the gauntlet, with a ±20 floor, signed by the attacker's facing, and priced at round(strength*1.5). Its target set is the melee verbs' own, so it respects the lane rule. Grievous-hit knockback and the arena-wall clamp at ±2100 are modelled.
cards.gaps: candidate-grievous-knockback has 0 observations. The build's three wall-cut routes (knockback spillover, the nudge stunlock, the command pull-through) are deliberately not reproduced (owner, 2026-09-22).
cards.next: Capture candidate-grievous-knockback.
cards.evidence: SS2_SHOVE and ss2ShoveForce (ss2-rules.js:4521-4560); SS2_ARENA.clamp (~1525-1553); test/ss2-shove.test.js. The 2026-09-19 Codex fix is recorded in the HANDOFF living head.

cards.title: Psyche up (charge and discharge)
cards.summary: Built b201486 (2026-09-16). Three presses, a counter resource with no default, and a discharge at direction 30 through the dispatcher. It is offered only on warrior frames at herolevel >= 7 and never with a bow drawn (2efddc9). The AI charges only when aiCharges is on, which is off by default.
cards.gaps: No candidate and no golden. The captures/psyche-probe-1 session aborted before a battle. The capture wrapper's archer psyche gate (tools/runtime-capture/ss2-capture-wrapper.as ~334-343) is still wrong and needs a Windows session plus validate-vehicle.ps1. Open build question: whether a menu slot hidden on an archer turn stays hidden on later warrior turns.
cards.next: Fix the wrapper gate on Windows, then read the PlaceObject/RemoveObject tags for the sticky-slot question.
cards.evidence: SS2_PSYCHE_UP (ss2-rules.js:4101); legalActions offer; createSs2TeamRules aiCharges docstring (~9298-9420): the charge is inert on the level-4 demo roster at any hitpointsmax; test/ss2-psyche-up.test.js, test/ss2-ai-charging.test.js.
cards.ownerDecision: Whether the AI should charge by default. It is a character trait that loses on damage per turn.

cards.title: Crowd verbs: wincrowd and cast_adulation
cards.summary: wincrowd (herolevel >= 3) adds round(charisma/2) to the crowd and takes zero combat samples; the clip pick is deterministic. Adulation (id 47) writes crowd_action 50. Wincrowd uses the ACTOR's charisma by owner decision; the build always reads the hero's.
cards.gaps: Map-derived only; no candidate or golden. The build's clip pick is RandomNumber(6), replaced by a deterministic pick. That is presentation, but it is still a named difference.
cards.next: None blocking. Keep as named in the divergence list.
cards.evidence: SS2_WINCROWD (ss2-rules.js:5731), SS2_ADULATION (5655); 951047e, cefaf83; test/ss2-wincrowd.test.js, test/ss2-adulation.test.js.

cards.title: Potions (drink_potion, items 2-9)
cards.summary: One verb for eight items, carrying itemId. The health, stamina and armour arms are exact to the build's multipliers, take zero samples, and consume the slot by writing 1 (the inventory's empty marker).
cards.gaps: Map-derived only; never captured.
cards.next: None beyond capture breadth.
cards.evidence: SS2_POTIONS and SS2_POTION_LADDER (ss2-rules.js:5983-6100); 0e1f421; test/ss2-drink-potion.test.js; inventory1-6 were declared in a506618 (goldens unmoved).

cards.title: Spells: direct damage (bolts 34/35, fireballs 30/31/32, molten death 49)
cards.summary: Built 2026-09-20 to 22. The bolts take one damage draw, no hit roll, and cost round(magicka) stamina with no affordability check. The fireballs take one draw and resolve at once, since the flight is flat and cannot miss. Molten death takes 1+4N samples for 10-20 boulders.
cards.gaps: The spell family has NEVER had a capture session: 8 candidate-spell-* fixtures, 0 observations. In team play every spell targets any foe with no lane, line or body gate, so a fireball flies through bodies. The latest handoff says no gate was found in the build and this is unverified. Frame-timed crowd edges (fireball impact tick, boulders landing into the next phase) are not reproduced. The capture wrapper has no spell_* staging (Windows).
cards.next: Add spell_* staging to the wrapper on Windows, then run the first spell capture session.
cards.evidence: SS2_BOLT_SPELLS (4770), SS2_FIREBALL_SPELLS (4926), SS2_DEATH_FROM_ABOVE (5173); 13e2129, 63931da, 68ce424; test/ss2-bolt.test.js, test/ss2-fireball.test.js, test/ss2-death-from-above.test.js.
cards.ownerDecision: How spells interact with ranks and intervening bodies in 2v2/3v3. The build has one body a side and cannot settle it.

cards.title: Spells: strike spells (whirlwind 37, ghost strike 36)
cards.summary: Whirlwind is the psyche discharge with an item for the charge: direction 30, facing-relative range gate, same lane only. Ghost strike is power_attack's 9-12 draw with no range test, a blink, and a back-attack judged from the landing point.
cards.gaps: Map-derived only. The same-lane restriction is authored. The back-attack bonus is an authored multiplier the build does not have.
cards.next: Capture once spell staging exists.

cards.title: Spells: displacement and utility (gale 38, command 39, teleport 48, weaken armour 44, rejuvinate 43)
cards.summary: All built 2026-09-22. Gale and command push and pull with zero samples. Teleport takes one draw for the destination. Weaken armour takes three direction draws into remove_armour. Rejuvinate is the full refill and restores the shoulderguard from its own backup (owner decision d).
cards.gaps: Never captured. The AI spending weaken armour on an unarmoured foe is kept deliberately (owner decision e).

cards.title: Spells: timed buffs and stat spells (regenerate 46, boundless energy 45, colossus 42, little fat kid 33, swiftsandals 40, bloodlust 41)
cards.summary: Built 2026-09-22. The counters are applied by nextphase on the bearer's phases. In team play a buff ticks on the bearer's own turn and on the first phase anyone else completes after it (owner decision c, authored invented resource timed_spell_tick_owed). The stat spells write from the fight-start backup_* and are restored when the counter runs out.
cards.gaps: Never captured. The team tick rule is authored. Colossus's 2 px/tick drift is deferred. The hero's per-round re-skin is not reproduced (owner decision a).
cards.next: Capture breadth.

cards.title: Status effects and weapon enchantments (frozen, burning, poison, life_stolen)
cards.summary: The enchantment proc runs on the attack path: one magicweapon_percentage roll against the PRIMARY potency. A condition then forces a status phase (86ccb68) that deals the INFLICTOR's enchantment damage through magic_damage_character at zero stamina cost. Status tokens carry their source (':from=') for team play.
cards.gaps: No golden carries an enchantment (potency 0 in all 23). candidate-frozen-enchantment-proc and candidate-armour-overflow-burning have 0 observations. The build lets the villain's spell ladder override a status phase; that is not reproduced (owner decision b). Source tagging is authored for team play.
cards.next: Capture candidate-frozen-enchantment-proc on the arena route with an enchanted weapon.

cards.title: Armour model (deflection, critical bypass, removal/debris, armour-first magic split, shield)
cards.summary: The attack path reproduces the deflection threshold, critical deflection, the >66 removal gate and the destroy/debris rules. The spell ingress applies armour first, then hitpoints once armourclass <= 0, with the breastplate stamina join.
cards.gaps: The armoured, champion and tournament candidate families (~15 fixtures) have 0 observations. The magic armour split has never been observed.
cards.next: Run the armoured/tournament capture families on the arena route.

cards.title: Defeat gate and fight modes
cards.summary: Play is tournament-only. duel and misc (first blood at hitpoints < hitpointsmax) are refused at construction unless fixtureReplay is set, because the resolver decides elimination on health > 0 and a mid-action refusal would leave RNG draws already spent. Draws exist through battleStanding.
cards.gaps: Team play cannot represent first blood at all. 22 of the 23 goldens are misc mode, a mode play never runs.
cards.next: Decide whether first-blood bouts are wanted. If so, the resolver needs a result channel beyond health > 0.
cards.evidence: ss2-rules.js:185-200, 9262, 9632-9639; src/team/elimination.js.
cards.ownerDecision: Whether first-blood (duel/misc) bouts belong in the team game.

cards.title: Villain AI: the spell ladder and stamina gates
cards.summary: All 28 arms of villain_cast_spells are reproduced in ladder order, pre-emption included (the seven possession-only sinks, and arm 23 before gale). The tired rest applies only in range, below the ladder. The zero-stamina rest and status phases are forced for everyone.
cards.gaps: The build's 90% ladder roll (+0x056f) is OMITTED; the AI takes no RNG samples at all. The villainChooseAction choices bands (~100, only 3 decoded) are NOT modelled, so the melee verb choice (quick/normal/power) is INVENTED (expected damage against the weakest reachable foe). The villain's stale decision distance is not reproduced (owner). No part of this AI has runtime backing.
cards.next: Fully decode the choices bands (+0x0b00-+0x0c00 at minimum) before claiming any AI fidelity.
cards.evidence: chooseAiAction (ss2-rules.js:14115-15566); battle map §The whole ladder (3997-4060); 5d2c8b7.
cards.ownerDecision: Whether the AI should take the build's own random draws (the 90% roll, the choices bands) rather than stay deterministic and sample-free.

cards.title: Team AI (authored layer): targeting, ranks, flanking, crowd and taunt valuation
cards.summary: Authored team behaviour on top of the ladder: swing at the weakest REACHABLE foe; walk at the own-rank foe; change rank only when its own rank is empty of foes; join an ally's fight (SS2_RANK_JOIN_SURPLUS 0); go round a foe an ally is fighting; draw the bow rather than walk; price taunts in hitpoints; play to the crowd when safe and ahead (SS2_AI_CROWD purseInSwings 100, aheadShare).
cards.gaps: The coefficients were tuned on the demo roster only. The latest handoff names residual render-sweep wall cases (a ghost strike cast facing away at the wall). The b81f3dc fix exposed that the AI could chase to the wall (16 of 25 tricks bouts stalled), so behaviour under new rosters is unmeasured.
cards.next: Re-census the AI on non-demo rosters, including the tournament bosses (?red=&blue=).
cards.evidence: ss2-rules.js:3142 (ss2FlankingWalk), 3295 (ss2TauntValue), 3529-3839 (SS2_AI_CROWD, ss2SafelyOutOfRange, ss2CrowdPleaserValue, ss2RankToJoin); bf53d81, b81f3dc, 69e4217; test/ss2-ai-crowd.test.js, test/ss2-flanking.test.js, test/ss2-rank-join.test.js, test/ss2-ai-tired-rest.test.js.

cards.title: Crowd economy and the victory purse
cards.summary: crowd_interest is modelled (cefaf83): one pool per battle, opening at the sum of all levels, fed by every completed phase, clamped 1..100. The adapter writes it back to _global. The purse is implemented as PURE functions: the build's 1v1 formula with the emperor's gift, and the owner's equal-share team purse.
cards.gaps: No settlement, campaign or host code pays the purse; campaign rewards are 'not started' (roadmap). crowd_bar's RandomNumber(1000) per tick is not modelled, and it matters for tape alignment. The frame-timed crowd edges are named, not reproduced.
cards.next: Wire the purse into settlement once the reward and progression decisions exist.
cards.evidence: src/team/ss2-crowd.js (SS2_CROWD_ACTION, ss2CrowdStep, ss2VictoryPurse, ss2TeamVictoryPurses); EffectKind.BATTLE_RESOURCE; 0cb8f78; test/ss2-crowd.test.js. A grep of src/ and tools/ finds NO caller of ss2VictoryPurse or ss2TeamVictoryPurses outside ss2-crowd.js.
cards.ownerDecision: Campaign reward and progression design (EP-D04 rewards, EP-A03 repair between fights, EP-D03 circuit length are all 'pending' in docs/design/endless-progression-decisions.md).

cards.title: Anti-stall crowd toll (SS2_CROWD)
cards.summary: An AUTHORED toll that is a pure function of turnNumber: damage ramps by 1 a turn past patience 200. It guarantees termination and adds no hashed state. It shares only a word with the build's crowd_interest.
cards.gaps: D1 residual: the toll is paid on the actor's own turn, so whoever acts first (higher agility) dies first in a pure stall. The findings doc says 'Noted rather than decided'.
cards.next: Decide the residual, or leave it deliberately and record that.
cards.evidence: ss2-rules.js:560-720 (SS2_CROWD, ss2CrowdDamage); docs/crowd-patience-findings-2026-09-11.md; docs/combat-economy-findings-2026-09-10.md D1.
cards.ownerDecision: Should a mutual stall end in a draw (toll everyone on each turn) or keep a loser (the current behaviour)?

cards.title: Team geometry: ranks, lanes, facing, back attacks, line of sight, arena wall
cards.summary: Three ranks at rankStride 97 (chosen by the owner). Melee, shove, taunt, whirlwind and discharge are same-lane only (owner rule, 2026-09-18). Facing is derived per team against every foe at opening, and fighters re-face after a kill or a swing. The back-attack bonus is 0.5 (authored). Snipe is body-blocked (authored). The wall clamps at ±2100. Everything is a no-op at rankStride 0, which keeps 1v1 and the goldens untouched.
cards.gaps: This is all authored mod surface (MAP_SILENCE.multi-slot-arena-geometry); no capture can settle it. Spells are not lane- or line-gated (see the direct-damage item). The back-attack bonus has no build counterpart.
cards.next: Design spell targeting across ranks.
cards.evidence: SS2_ARENA (ss2-rules.js:1425-1560), ss2SameLane/ss2ShotBlocked (~2560-2660), ss2FacingEffects (2818), SS2_BACK_ATTACK_BONUS (7090); 71eb5aa (1v1 identical over 168,134 actions); test/ss2-facing-lanes.test.js, test/ss2-position.test.js.

cards.title: Initiative and turn order
cards.summary: Sides alternate (ss2InitiativeOrder). The side with the single fastest gladiator opens; within a side the order is agility descending, then id; uneven sides interleave, then the remainder goes in order. This is authored for team play; the build alternates two fighters.
cards.gaps: Who opens and the within-side order are authored and unsettleable by capture. It interacts with the D1 stall residual (a faster fighter loses a pure stall).
cards.next: None.
cards.evidence: ss2-rules.js:992-1049; MAP_SILENCE.initiative-order; combat-economy-findings D3 (closed 2026-09-10).

cards.title: Roster, AI fill, controllers, elimination, once-only settlement
cards.summary: The structural seam: 1-3 slots a side, per-slot AI fill through the same constructor, seat-to-controller registry kept out of the combat hash, knockout distinct from settlement, and settlement gated on both elimination and an animation ack tied to a per-battle discriminator.
cards.gaps: The resolver and the src/engine.js façade still DEFAULT to placeholder rules; only hosts that pass ss2TeamRules get SS2 behaviour.
cards.next: None.
cards.evidence: src/team/roster.js, controllers.js, elimination.js, settlement.js; roadmap 'How the constraints are met'; test/team-controllers.test.js, test/team-resolver.test.js, test/hotseat.test.js.

cards.title: RNG, replay, state hash and wire state
cards.summary: One ordered, labelled RNG channel with a seeded mode (the pre-seam integer generator, not the build's Math.random) and a strict tape mode matching the golden sample shape. Deterministic replay. combatStateHash covers per-combatant and top-level state. BATTLE_STATE_VERSION is derived from both key lists (69873a2). Rule-set options that change behaviour are folded into the rule-set id so the hash sees them.
cards.gaps: In tape mode the samples themselves are not hashed (the state is 0 and only the cursor moves), so peers with different tapes hash alike until they diverge. Event shapes, team entries and settlement below the top level are not versioned. Stage 7 transport (host-authoritative sync, reconnect) is not started, and EP-D07 (on an unmerged branch) forbids AI takeover on disconnect.
cards.next: Decide whether to project the RNG mode and a sample digest into the hash before any online work.

cards.title: Combatant construction: stat derivation, weapon table, shop gate, tournament bosses
cards.summary: ss2BattleValues/ss2Combatant derive the damage pair from the 90-row weapon table, weapon_range with the bow override, the maximum_ammo tier chain, hitpointsmax, staminamax, movement speed and enchantment damage. The shop gate is enforced except for weapons never bought. Tournament bosses are decoded from their DNA (a62e67a, 3f386d7).
cards.gaps: The weapon table is not runtime-corroborated (HANDOFF open items). character_xp is not derived. The inventory_maxslots level chain is deliberately not reproduced. The villain-side experience-write hazard is not reproduced. The 5 champion candidates have 0 observations.
cards.next: Capture one champion bout on the arena route.

cards.title: Verification corpus: goldens vs map-derived vs authored
cards.summary: 23 goldens, 60 candidates, 69 observations (62 cited by goldens), 86 preserved divergence reports. 37 candidates have no golden: 36 with zero observations, plus duel-firstblood-normal-kill with one. The spell family was never captured. Of 42 action types, only quick, normal and power have any runtime backing, and only for hit and damage arithmetic.
cards.gaps: Golden traces echo roll labels and bounds from the candidate. 18 of the 23 goldens rest on operator-string identity plus the pre-nonce waiver. No clip, depth or position has ever been observed.
